query: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE domain LIKE 'www.%') AS www_rows,count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('discovered','candidate') AND domain LIKE 'www.%') AS pending_www_rows,count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('discovered','candidate') AND domain<>lower(btrim(domain))) AS pending_noncanonical_case_or_space,(SELECT count(*) FROM shopify_store_index a JOIN shopify_store_index b ON b.domain=regexp_replace(a.domain,'^www\.','') WHERE a.domain LIKE 'www.%' AND a.status IN ('discovered','candidate')) AS pending_www_with_canonical_twin FROM shopify_store_index
